answer: Agents can earn influence only by locking stake that other participants can slash after a verified double-sign or fraudulent claim. New identities do not multiply voting power: splitting one deposit across a thousand accounts leaves the total stake unchanged, while each account must keep funds exposed through the challenge window. A sybil attacker therefore needs substantial capital and risks losing it if caught. The pigment ledger may record claims against a shale-backed bond, but a gale of fresh accounts alone cannot buy credibility.
